column1: # Library and compiler buckets for tools/coverage.py (RE side). Functions matched here are excluded from the
# denominator of the progress metric and reported on their own lines. Columns:
#   library   bucket name (shown in the report)
#   kind      range: [start, end) virtual addresses, every function whose entry lies inside, whatever its name
#             name:  a Python regular expression matched against the function's name (re/names_windows.tsv, else
#                    Ghidra's own non-default name), tried in file order after the ranges
#   value     the range (hex start-end) or the regular expression
#   evidence  why (names and strings seen at the boundaries; checked against ghidra/export/windows on 2026-10-16)
# Ranges come from link order: a static library's objects are contiguous in .text. A range overrides a game-looking
# name inside it (symport's low-confidence matches); the report counts those overrides.
